arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: KIS KI HAI BETI, KIS KI BEHAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHOSE DAUGHTER IS THIS, WHOSE SISTER IS SPEAKING?

arabic text: KHAMOSH MUSALMAN SUNO SAR KO JHUKA KAR
english translation text: O SILENT MUSLIMS, LISTEN WITH YOUR HEADS BOWED.

arabic text: BAZAAR MEIN HAMSHEER-E-HASSAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: IN THE MARKETPLACE, THE SISTER OF HASAN IS SPEAKING.

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: KYUN KAR NA LARZAY QASR-E-YAZEEDI KHITAAB SE
english translation text: HOW COULD YAZID’S PALACE NOT TREMBLE AT THIS ADDRESS,

arabic text: GHAZI HAI JIS KE DIL MEIN DAFAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHEN THE ONE SPEAKING CARRIES A BURIED WARRIOR WITHIN HER HEART?

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: CHAADAR TO NAHIN ZAINAB-E-DILGEER KE SAR PAR
english translation text: THERE IS NO VEIL UPON THE HEAD OF GRIEF-STRICKEN ZAINAB,

arabic text: KHAAK-E-SHIFA KA ORHAY KAFAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: SHE SPEAKS, WRAPPED INSTEAD IN THE DUST OF SHIFA AS HER SHROUD.

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: AISI JAGAH JAHAAN PAR AIK PARDAH-DAAR KA
english translation text: IN A PLACE WHERE, FOR A MODEST WOMAN,

arabic text: HOTA HAI SAANS LENA GHUTAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: EVEN BREATHING BECOMES SUFFOCATION — SHE SPEAKS.

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: LEHJE KA JOSH DEKH KE HOTA NAHIN YAQEEN
english translation text: SEEING THE FIRE IN HER TONE, ONE CANNOT BELIEVE

arabic text: KARB-O-BALA KI TASHNA-DAHAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: THAT THIS IS THE THIRSTY-LIPPED SURVIVOR OF KARBALA SPEAKING.

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: MASOOM SAKINA, TERE DAAMAN KI AAG KI
english translation text: O INNOCENT SAKINA, OF THE FIRE WITHIN YOUR HEM,

arabic text: REHTI HAI SAATH JIS KE JALAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: THE BURNING THAT STAYS WITH HER — SHE SPEAKS.

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: AKBAR KO LAGI BARCHHI, KE ASGHAR KE TEER KI
english translation text: WHETHER IT WAS AKBAR STRUCK BY THE SPEAR, OR ASGHAR BY THE ARROW,

arabic text: HOTI HAI JIS KE DIL MEIN CHUBHAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: THE ONE WHOSE HEART BEARS THOSE WOUNDS IS SPEAKING.

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: BAITAY HAIN KURSIYON PE KITNAY AARAAM SE
english translation text: HOW COMFORTABLY THEY SIT UPON THEIR THRONES,

arabic text: HAI JIS KO KARBALA KI THAKAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHILE THE ONE EXHAUSTED BY KARBALA SPEAKS.

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: QURBAAN KAR KE BAITON KO BHAI HUSSAIN PAR
english translation text: HAVING SACRIFICED HER SONS FOR HER BROTHER HUSSAIN,

arabic text: MAATHAY PE JIS KE THI NA SHIKAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: SHE WHOSE FOREHEAD NEVER SHOWED A CREASE OF COMPLAINT SPEAKS.

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?

arabic text: TAUQEER KAHA SHIMR NE TU KYUN KHAMOSH HAI
english translation text: ‘WHY ARE YOU SILENT?’ SHIMR MOCKINGLY ASKED,

arabic text: ABBAS DEKH TERI BEHN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: O ABBAS, BEHOLD — YOUR SISTER IS SPEAKING.

arabic text: HAI KAUN JO PABAND-E-RASAN BOL RAHI HAI
english translation text: WHO IS THIS, SPEAKING WHILE BOUND IN CHAINS?
